title: Dutch TTF front-month jumps 6% as Norwegian outage tightens supply
text: Dutch TTF front-month gas rose 6% to 38.4 EUR/MWh after unplanned maintenance at a Norwegian processing plant cut flows by 25 mcm/d. Traders also pointed to a cold snap forecast for northwest Europe next week.

title: EU gas storage reaches 91% as mild weather curbs withdrawals
text: European gas storage is 91% full, ahead of the usual schedule. Mild temperatures reduced heating demand and withdrawals fell for a third week, keeping the market well supplied.

title: EU carbon allowances fall to 68 EUR/t on weaker industrial demand
text: EUA benchmark December contracts slid 3% to 68 EUR/t as weak industrial output reduced expected emissions. Analysts see the decline continuing unless the EU Commission tightens the cap.

title: German baseload power drops as record wind output floods the grid
text: German day-ahead baseload power fell to 41 EUR/MWh as wind generation exceeded 40 GW, the highest this year. Demand was weak ahead of the weekend, pushing prices lower across the region.

title: French nuclear maintenance halts two reactors, lifting power prices
text: Two French reactors were taken offline for unplanned maintenance, removing 2.6 GW of capacity. French day-ahead power rose 8% as imports from Germany increased.

title: Local council approves new cycle lanes in city centre
text: The council voted on Tuesday to add protected cycle lanes along the main shopping street, with construction starting next spring.
